study.question: Which auxiliary task group should be allowed to update shared user/context representations when item-value and selector ownership are already separated: cart/fav, buy, both, or neither?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: context sharing with live auxiliary gradients has click validation AUC 0.6662458901487431, whereas shared/detached and both private-context cells give exactly 0.6659481622737187 (difference +0.0002977278750244, one seed). This aggregate benefit leaves task provenance unresolved. The prospective mechanism is task-selective backward sharing: cart/fav gradients provide useful shared-context updates, while the rarer buy task may contribute less or oppose them. Predicted ordering is cart/fav-only above none and at least as good as all, with buy-only no better than cart/fav-only. This is a falsifiable working hypothesis, not an observed task-level attribution. All cells expose the same context values to every tower; stopped auxiliary losses still train their towers and private item/selector components.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text section 4.3 lines 250-277 verifies target-conditioned, unnormalized local-activation pooling. That pooling is inherited through the benchmark adaptation; the present intervention changes only task-specific derivatives into shared context, not DIN pooling. No exact paper reproduction or novelty claim.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-170 create task-specific sequence hubs and task/shared hub tokens for stacked information exchange. The proposed study introduces no hub, token, broadcast, or new forward interaction: the existing representation is shared in value and partitioned only in backward task ownership. This is a code-level comparison to the benchmark adaptation, not original-paper equivalence.

Original-paper provenance resolved; the authorized reader reports detailed original text unavailable and directs to an explicit benchmark fallback. Broad closest-work completeness and priority remain unverified; no new-method originality claim.

Exact parent source and receipt checked. Previously all auxiliary context gradients were live together. Add two independent static booleans to permit cart/fav versus buy derivatives while preserving all values, modules and losses.

study.proposed_difference: Add context_cart_fav_live and context_buy_live booleans. At the auxiliary tower input only, apply detach() to the unchanged shared context tensor for tasks whose group is disabled. is_click always keeps the original live context. Cross the two booleans in a full 2x2. There are no new parameters, random draws, loss weights, information inputs, or runtime model filesystem/network calls. This is an attribution study and possible selective-sharing candidate; it is not an asserted new architecture.
predictions: All four cells should have equal initial predictions, allocated parameter counts (expected 63939643 from the parent), and unchanged mask behavior; only selected task-to-context derivatives differ. Host forward/backward and BF16 checks must establish this before training.

All-enabled should reproduce g3-r0023-context_shared_live and none-enabled should reproduce g3-r0023-context_shared_detached under the same deterministic recipe; historical matches are implementation checks, not independent evidence.

Primary directional hypothesis: A10 > A00 and A10 >= A11, where first bit enables cart/fav and second bit enables buy; A01 <= A10. Report actual signs and magnitudes without imposing a significance threshold on a single seed.
Report the two simple cart/fav effects A10-A00 and A11-A01, two buy effects A01-A00 and A11-A10, and interaction A11-A10-A01+A00. A large interaction would contradict a simple additive explanation.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss, primary loss and inherited history-length slices with sample and positive/negative counts; auxiliary quality may trade off against the primary. Capacity is matched; allocated GPU/wall seconds, memory, throughput and latency are measured by the host, not inferred from parameters.
falsifiers: If A10 does not beat A00 or A10 is below A11, the predicted harmful-or-unhelpful buy contribution is unsupported in this implementation. If A01 dominates A10, the predicted group ordering is reversed.

If A11-A10 is positive at both cart/fav settings, retain a positive-buy explanation rather than interpreting rarity as negative transfer. If only joint activation helps, prefer an interaction explanation.

If either all/none endpoint fails to reproduce the corresponding exact parent receipt beyond host numerical reproducibility, investigate source/config/training differences before making task-attribution claims.

Initial prediction, parameter-count, mask, label-order, gradient-boundary or budget failure invalidates this implementation contrast; retain the failed receipt and do not call it a scientific refutation.
alternative_explanations: Joint optimization, changing auxiliary tower trajectories and shared Adagrad state are part of each intervention; no pure gradient-alignment measurement is available
Dense global clipping can indirectly couple tasks even where context gradients are stopped; sparse embedding gradients are outside that clipping scope
Only one fixed seed is authorized in the current suite; historical all/none endpoints are deterministic same-seed checks, not independent repetitions

Cart/fav are grouped prospectively for a four-cell design, using their higher observed validation positive counts (10428/7717 versus buy 4036); this does not establish equivalent training gradients or semantic mechanisms
Equal allocated capacity and matching forward tensor operations do not imply equal active trainable capacity, backward cost or measured wall time
Same-seed selection after many trajectories can exaggerate small improvements; user-cluster uncertainty and paired independent seeds are needed before repeated-support claims

The context gain could reflect regularization, sparse optimizer update magnitudes or task prevalence rather than complementary information; no representation or gradient-alignment diagnostics have yet isolated those explanations
The whole-window benchmark vocabularies/static snapshots and official_offline feedback maturity assumptions limit production or causal interpretation

Latest knowledge-usage review: declared DIN use is inherited pooling provenance; INFNet/EST/MixFormer/Zenith were considered, with no local causal evidence of knowledge value. The previous four context variants executed successfully. Context_shared_live reproduced selector_disabled, while private and stopped-context cells shared identical click metrics; thus allocating context capacity or forward access alone did not explain the current small click gain. Original INFNet and other source-method paper detail remains unverified; this proposal does not upgrade it to verified novelty.
